issue.title: Agent MoE Experiment: 2x long-context skew at qk=1.75
issue.body:
## TL;DR

Launch a production-priority v4-2048 treatment twin of the qk=1.75 262K context-extension run. The treatment preserves the control's checkpoint, optimizer, schedule, mesh, batch size, data offset, and quality-by-domain weights while sampling long-context data at 2x its proportional rate.

## Description

The control extends the step-156,000 cooldown checkpoint from 65K to 262K context for 1,000 steps at batch size 256. The treatment uses the length-partitioned Datakit store from #8656 and repeats the >64K partition twice within each phase-1 component.

User request: “Cool, can you launch QK 1.75 with data skew of 2x on long context data”

## Hypothesis or Goal

Measure the effect of a 2x long-document sampling skew against the qk=1.75 context-extension control without changing its training configuration or quality-by-domain distribution.

## Status

Preparing the pinned launcher, run record, and production-priority Iris submission.
